ai.seo_question: What happens to mountains on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this imagery from Surah Al-Mursalat underscores the absolute power of Allah to dismantle the earth's most enduring structures, serving as a precursor to the Great Resurrection. The transformation of mountains into 'carded wool' (al-'ihn) symbolizes the complete dissolution of worldly stability, a theme often linked to the cosmic signs preceding the appearance of the Mahdi.
